messages.subject: Re: Roary gene presence and Newick file gheatmap help
parts:
thetree <- ggtree(tree, size=0.5)+geom_tiplab(color="black", size=2) + ggplot2::xlim(0,0.05) + geom_treescale(fontsize = 2)

remove + ggplot2::xlim(0,0.05) and everything should works fine.


On Tue, Oct 2, 2018 at 4:34 AM Erin Young <erin...@gmail.com> wrote:
I have some data for some Salmonella samples that I'm trying to make look pretty. I want a phylogenetic tree on the left, and a heatmap of gene presence/absence next to it on the right. 

I thought ggtree would help, but I am a little stuck. Admittedly, I'm a little new to R, so I imagine my problem has already been solved and I was just unable to find it.

I want to add a heatmap of gene presence/absence from Roary to a newick tree that I generated with iqtree. Note, some of my sample names begin with numbers so I have read them into a table with check.names = FALSE.

What I have attempted to do (relevant files attached):

library(ggplot2)
library(ggtree)
library(treeio)

# creating the tree - which works great!
tree <- read.newick("OUTBREAK_120_2018-09-05_other_Salmonella_all_IQTREE_2018-09-05.iqtree.treefile")
thetree <- ggtree(tree, size=0.5)+geom_tiplab(color="black", size=2) + ggplot2::xlim(0,0.05) + geom_treescale(fontsize = 2)

# modifying the roary output for heatmap generation 
gene_presence <- read.table("OUTBREAK_120_2018-09-05_other_Salmonella_all_Roary_out_gene_presence_absence.Rtab", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
row.names(gene_presence) <- gene_presence[,1]
gene_presence <- gene_presence[,-1]
gene_presence = t(gene_presence)

# what I want to do:
gheatmap(thetree, gene_presence)

--
G Yu, DK Smith, H Zhu, Y Guan, TTY Lam*. ggtree: an R package for visualization and annotation of phylogenetic trees with their covariates and other associated data, Methods in Ecology and Evolution, 2017, 8(1):28-36. doi:10.1111/2041-210X.12628
